description: Removes the clip at a timeline position (one clip; ambiguity across tracks needs track), or every placement of a named region. delete_region also drops the region itself unless other clips use it.

at.description: Timeline position of the clip (exclusive with region)

delete_region.description: Also delete the region from the pool

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

task.description: Name of the task this edit is part of, e.g. "remove speech pauses". In the open app, all edits with the same task name become one undo step: keep the name for every call of the task and change it when the next task starts. Without a task name, all edits of this session share one step

unit.description: Unit for positions (default bars; bars/beats are 1-based, seconds/clocks absolute)

name: remove_clip
title: Remove clips
